program.name: Gentle Start
program.subject: Gentle / low impact
program.blurb: Easy-going strength circuits with a chair and a wall, then a gentle stretch. A kind way back in.
program.about: A kind way into exercise, or back into it after a break. Each session is a relaxed circuit of sit-to-stands, wall push-ups, bridges and bird dogs, at your own pace with a breather between rounds, then a gentle stretch. Nothing jumps and nothing hurries. Levels II and III add a few reps to each move. Twenty minutes or so.
program.gear: A chair and a clear bit of wall.
